name: Prophet
summary: An additive forecasting model (trend + seasonality + holidays) designed for quick, tunable business forecasts.
inputs: A dated series (ds, y); optional holidays and extra regressors.
outputs: Forecasts with uncertainty intervals and component plots.

data_requirements.min_observations: At least one full seasonal cycle, ideally several

assumptions: Daily or sub-daily business data with strong calendar effects
math_summary: y(t) = g(t) + s(t) + h(t) + e_t: piecewise linear or logistic trend with changepoints, Fourier-series seasonalities and holiday indicators, fitted with Stan (MAP by default).
when_to_use: Many business series needing a quick, tunable baseline by analysts
when_not_to_use: Financial returns or prices (little seasonality; poor fit)
When a well-tuned ARIMA/ETS or boosting baseline is available and accuracy matters
pitfalls: Default changepoint settings can over- or under-fit trend
Should be compared against simple baselines

compute.complexity: Fast MAP fit per series; full MCMC optional and slower.

applicability.use_case: Daily electricity demand with weekly and yearly seasonality and holidays
Forecasting daily Treasury cash balances with calendar effects

theory.rationale: A curve-fitting model (trend, seasonality, holidays) with no autoregressive dynamics; intervals rest on trend-uncertainty heuristics.

ease.rationale: Very easy to run in Python or R with readable components.

fit.rationale: Weak fit for financial series with little seasonality; reasonable only for calendar-driven demand data.
